verdict.rationale: Docs cover multiple checkout integration paths (links, embed, session API), official TypeScript & Python SDKs with type safety, and a full sandbox with test cards for end-to-end testing — enough to plausibly integrate in a day. However, the pack shows no actual copy-paste code snippets, no confirmation of SDKs beyond two languages, and no explicit 'under a day' benchmarking or hands-on developer report of time-to-integrate. Missing for 10: visible code-sample snippets in docs, broader language SDK coverage, independent hands-on confirmation of integration speed.
